summary: Aurelion Inc., a Hong Kong-domiciled foreign private issuer (formerly Prestige Wealth Inc.), furnished a Form 6-K disclosing board approval on November 6, 2026, of a Digital Asset Management Committee overseeing digital asset treasury activities. The two voting members are Chairman Chang-Wei Chiu (chair) and CEO Frank Zheng; Chief Accounting Officer Joyce Zheng may attend as a non-voting adviser. No stake, price, premium, advisor, or closing terms were disclosed. The committee manages acquisition, custody, deployment, and disposal within board-set risk parameters; material transactions still require board approval. This is a routine governance action, not a special situation; watch for subsequent treasury disclosures.
